basic.name: Empower Sulfuras
basic.description:
Ragnaros's next Basic Attack is instant, dealing 191~~0.04~~ Ability damage in an area, and heals for 20% of the damage dealt. Healing doubled versus Heroes.

Molten Core: Molten Swing
Stun and damage nearby enemies.

basic.name: Living Meteor
basic.description:
Vector Targeting
Summon a meteor at the target point that deals 68~~0.04~~ damage, then rolls in the target direction dealing 272~~0.04~~ damage per second for 1.75 seconds.

Molten Core: Meteor Shower
Drop a line of meteor impacts.

basic.name: Blast Wave
basic.description:
Ignite Ragnaros or an ally, granting 25% Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds before exploding dealing 120~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies.

Molten Core: Explosive Rune
Cause a delayed explosion in a large area.

basic.name: Empower Sulfuras
basic.description:

Stun and damage nearby enemies.

basic.name: Shifting Meteor
basic.description: Change the direction of Living Meteor.

basic.name: Molten Swing
basic.description: Swing Sulfuras in a wide arc, dealing 250~~0.04~~ damage and Stunning enemies for 1 second.

basic.name: Meteor Shower
basic.description:
Vector Targeting
Summon 3 meteors at the target point that fall in the target direction. Each meteor deals 200~~0.04~~ damage and Slows enemies by 35% for 2 seconds.

basic.name: Explosive Rune
basic.description: Create a rune that erupts after 1.5 and sets enemies on fire, dealing 22~~0.04~~ damage per second for 5 seconds.

heroic.name: Sulfuras Smash
heroic.description:
Hurl Sulfuras at the target area, landing after 0.75 seconds, dealing 250~~0.04~~ damage. Enemies in the center take 594~~0.04~~ damage instead and are Stunned for 0.5 seconds.

Quest: Hit 8 enemy Heroes in the center.

Mythic Reward: Sulfuras Smash gains an additional charge.

heroic.name: Lava Wave
heroic.description: Release a wave of lava from Ragnaros's Core that travels down the targeted lane, dealing 240~~0.04~~ damage per second to non-Structure enemies in its path and instantly killing enemy Minions. Damage increased by 100% versus Heroes.

heroic.name: Sulfuras Smash
heroic.description:

Quest: Hit 8 enemy Heroes in the center.

Mythic Reward: Sulfuras Smash gains an additional charge.

trait.name: Molten Core
trait.description:
Channel on an allied or destroyed Fort or Keep to replace it with Ragnaros's ultimate form, temporarily gaining new Abilities, having 5000~~0.04~~ Health that burns away over 23 seconds.  Ragnaros's ability ranges increase over the duration of Molten Core.

Ragnaros returns to his normal form but is Stunned for 1 second upon losing all Health in Molten Core.

activable.name: Catching Fire
activable.description: Activate to gain 25 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 25%.

activable.name: Resilient Flame
activable.description:
When Ragnaros is Stunned, he gains 40 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 40%. 

This effect has a 15 second cooldown.

activable.name: Submerge
activable.description: Ragnaros submerges below, entering Stasis and healing for 600~~0.04~~ Health over 3 seconds.

level1.name: Sulfuras Hungers
level1.description:
Quest: Every time Empower Sulfuras kills a Minion, its damage is increased by 1, up to 25.

Reward: After killing 25 Minions, increase its damage by an additional 100.

level1.name: Shifting Meteor
level1.description:
Each time an enemy is hit by the same Living Meteor, they take 6% increased damage from it.

Quest: Hit 75 Heroes with Living Meteor.

Reward: After hitting 75 Heroes with Living Meteor, its duration is increased to 2.25 seconds, and it can be reactivated to change its direction once per use.

level1.name: Engulfing Flame
level1.description: Increase Blast Wave's damage by 50% and its radius by 15%.

level4.name: Fire Ward
level4.description:
When Living Meteor hits an enemy Hero, gain a charge of Spell Armor, reducing damage from the next enemy ability by 50%.

Stores up to 2 charges.

level4.name: Slow Burn
level4.description: Blast Wave Slows enemies hit by 40% for 2 seconds.

level4.name: Catching Fire
level4.description:
Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Ragnaros' Health Regeneration by 1.25 per second, up to 18.75.

Reward: After gathering 15 Regeneration Globes, activate Catching Fire to gain 25 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 25%.

level7.name: Hand of Ragnaros
level7.description: If Empower Sulfuras hits at least 2 enemy Heroes, refund 10 Mana and its cooldown recharges 100% faster for 4 seconds.

level7.name: Molten Power
level7.description: If Living Meteor hits enemy Heroes at least 5 times, reduce its cooldown by 7 seconds, and refund 30 Mana.

level7.name: Blistering Attacks
level7.description: Every 10 seconds, Ragnaros's next Basic Attack against a Hero deals 60% bonus damage. Hitting enemies with Basic Abilities reduces this cooldown by 1 second.

level13.name: Cauterize Wounds
level13.description: Empower Sulfuras heals for an additional 45% of damage dealt to Heroes over 2 seconds.

level13.name: Tempered Flame
level13.description: When Blast Wave damages an enemy Hero, gain a Shield equal to 100% of the damage dealt for 3 seconds.

level13.name: Resilient Flame
level13.description:
When Ragnaros is Stunned, he gains 40 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 40%. 

This effect has a 15 second cooldown.

level16.name: Giant Scorcher
level16.description: Empower Sulfuras burns enemy Heroes for 9% of their maximum Health over 3 seconds. This additional damage does not heal Ragnaros.

level16.name: Meteor Bomb
level16.description: Living Meteor explodes at the end of its path, dealing 220~~0.04~~ damage. Enemies at its center take 30% increased damage.

level16.name: Blast Echo
level16.description: After Blast Wave explodes, another Blast Wave is created on Ragnaros.

level20.name: Flames of Sulfuron
level20.description: Sulfuras Smash Slows enemies by 50% for 2.5 seconds, and the Stun duration of enemies hit in the center is increased by 1 second.

level20.name: Lava Surge
level20.description: Lava Wave gains an additional charge and causes allied Minions and non-Boss Mercenaries to be carried with it.

level20.name: Heroic Difficulty
level20.description: Molten Core's range is increased by 100% at the start of its duration.  In addition, the cooldown of Molten Core is reduced by 110 seconds when used on a destroyed Fort or Keep.

level20.name: Submerge
level20.description: Ragnaros submerges below, entering Stasis and healing for 600~~0.04~~ Health over 3 seconds.
